words.enDefinition: A counter where people arrange postal services

examples.en: I took the envelope to the postal counter after my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上午的讲座结束后，我把信封拿到了「邮政服务柜台」。

examples.en: The sign above the postal counter listed services for sending letters and official documents.
examples.zh: 「邮政服务柜台」上方的牌子列出了寄信和寄送官方文件的服务。

collocations: hand something over at the postal counter

words.enDefinition: A worker who assists customers at a post office

examples.en: The postal clerk checked whether my envelope would fit through the size guide.
examples.zh: 「邮局柜台工作人员」检查了我的信封能不能通过尺寸测量板。

examples.en: I asked the postal clerk which part of the receipt I should keep.
examples.zh: 我问「邮局柜台工作人员」该保留凭条的哪一部分。

collocations: a receipt from the postal clerk

words.enDefinition: A person who delivers letters and other mail

examples.en: The mail carrier brought an envelope from the local administration office that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，「邮递员」送来一个地方行政办公室寄出的信封。

examples.en: I met the mail carrier at the entrance to our student residence.
examples.zh: 我在学生宿舍入口遇到了「邮递员」。

collocations: a letter delivered by a mail carrier

words.enDefinition: An organization that collects and delivers mail

examples.en: The government notice named the postal operator handling the return of official documents.
examples.zh: 政府通知写明了负责寄回官方文件的「邮政运营机构」。

examples.en: I checked which postal operator had issued the receipt for the mailed letter.
examples.zh: 我查看了寄信凭条是由哪家「邮政运营机构」出具的。

collocations: a receipt from a postal operator

words.enDefinition: A local UK postal office handling mail delivery

examples.en: The Royal Mail card named a delivery office near my university as the collection point.
examples.zh: 英国皇家邮政的通知卡写明，取件地点是学校附近的一个「邮政投递办事点」。

examples.en: I asked which entrance led to the delivery office printed on the card.
examples.zh: 我问去通知卡上写的「邮政投递办事点」要从哪个入口进。

collocations: collect mail from a delivery office

words.enDefinition: A narrow opening through which letters are delivered

examples.en: The official envelope was waiting beneath the letter slot when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回家时，官方信封已经放在「投信口」下面。

examples.en: A volunteer showed me the letter slot in the office's outside door.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看办公室外门上的「投信口」。

collocations: a letter slot in a door
push mail through a letter slot

words.enDefinition: The university office that handles mail

examples.en: I asked the campus mailroom whether the government letter had arrived for me.
examples.zh: 我问「校园邮件收发室」，寄给我的政府来信到了没有。

examples.en: The campus mailroom sent a message about a document envelope addressed to me.
examples.zh: 「校园邮件收发室」发来消息，说有一个写着我姓名的文件信封。

collocations: collect mail from the campus mailroom

words.enDefinition: Mail collected for sending from a location

examples.en: I asked which tray was for outgoing mail at the student services office.
examples.zh: 我问学生服务办公室哪个托盘放的是「待寄出的邮件」。

examples.en: The campus mailroom collects outgoing mail from the department's front desk each afternoon.
examples.zh: 校园邮件收发室每天下午从系里的前台收取「待寄出的邮件」。

words.enDefinition: Mail arriving at an office or address

examples.en: The receptionist was sorting incoming mail when I asked about my document envelope.
examples.zh: 我问起文件信封时，接待员正在整理「收到的邮件」。

examples.en: I checked the folder for incoming mail from the agency that handles registration.
examples.zh: 我查看了归档「收到的邮件」的文件夹，找负责登记的机构寄来的信。

words.enDefinition: The time when deposited mail is picked up

examples.en: The postbox had a plate showing the mail collection time for weekdays.
examples.zh: 邮筒上有一块牌子，写着工作日的「邮筒收信时间」。

examples.en: I checked the mail collection time before deciding where to post the form.
examples.zh: 决定到哪里寄表格之前，我查看了「邮筒收信时间」。

words.enDefinition: The final pickup of posted mail that day

examples.en: The last collection was listed on a small sign beside the postbox.
examples.zh: 邮筒旁的小牌子上写着「当天最后收信时间」。

examples.en: I asked whether the last collection had already happened at that branch.
examples.zh: 我问那个网点当日是否已经进行了「最后一次收信」。

collocations: check the time of the last collection

words.enDefinition: An envelope lined with cushioning material

examples.en: I bought a padded envelope to protect the small card I was mailing.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「缓冲信封」，用来保护要寄的小卡片。

examples.en: The postal clerk handed me a padded envelope from the shelf behind her.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员从身后的架子上拿了一个「缓冲信封」给我。

collocations: send something in a padded envelope

words.enDefinition: An envelope designed to hold papers or documents

examples.en: I put the certificate into a document envelope that was wide enough to close easily.
examples.zh: 我把证书放进了一个够宽、容易封口的「文件信封」。

examples.en: The envelope shelf had a document envelope large enough for my folded papers.
examples.zh: 信封货架上有一个足够装下我折好文件的「文件信封」。

words.enDefinition: An envelope with a clear address window

examples.en: I could see the university office name through the window envelope on my desk.
examples.zh: 我透过桌上「开窗信封」的透明窗口，看到了大学办事处的名称。

examples.en: The letter was folded so the address showed through the window envelope.
examples.zh: 信纸折好后，地址正好能从「开窗信封」的窗口露出来。

collocations: send a letter in a window envelope

words.enDefinition: An envelope designed to obscure its contents

examples.en: The notice arrived in a security envelope with a patterned lining inside.
examples.zh: 通知装在一个内层印有图案的「防透视信封」里寄到。

examples.en: I asked for a security envelope before mailing the document from campus.
examples.zh: 我从学校寄文件前，要了一个「防透视信封」。

collocations: mail a document in a security envelope

words.enDefinition: An envelope with its own adhesive seal

examples.en: I chose a self-seal envelope from the shelf at the postal counter.
examples.zh: 我从邮政服务柜台的货架上挑了一个「自封式信封」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me a self-seal envelope in a size that fit my letter.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我看了一个大小适合装我那封信的「自封式信封」。

words.enDefinition: Stiff packaging that helps keep mailed items flat

examples.en: I used a rigid mailer to send the certificate without folding it.
examples.zh: 我用「硬质邮寄封套」寄证书，这样不用把证书折起来。

examples.en: The clerk showed me a rigid mailer that was wider than the document.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我看了一个比文件更宽的「硬质邮寄封套」。

collocations: a certificate in a rigid mailer

words.enDefinition: A long tube used to mail rolled items

examples.en: I put my exhibition poster into a mailing tube before going to the post office.
examples.zh: 去邮局之前，我把展览海报装进了「邮寄纸筒」。

examples.en: The postal clerk asked whether the cap was attached to my mailing tube.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员问，我的「邮寄纸筒」有没有装好盖子。

collocations: send a poster in a mailing tube

words.enDefinition: An envelope with postage already covered

examples.en: The letter included a postage-paid envelope for sending the form back to the office.
examples.zh: 信里附了一个「邮资已付信封」，用于把表格寄回办公室。

examples.en: I asked which marking showed it was a postage-paid envelope in the sample.
examples.zh: 我问样本上的哪个标记说明它是「邮资已付信封」。

collocations: return a form in a postage-paid envelope

words.enDefinition: An envelope addressed to oneself for a reply

examples.en: The form's cover page mentioned a self-addressed envelope among the enclosed items.
examples.zh: 表格封面在随附物品中提到了一个「写好自己地址的信封」。

examples.en: I asked whether the self-addressed envelope should carry my current student residence details.
examples.zh: 我问「写好自己地址的信封」要不要用现在的学生宿舍信息。

collocations: write your name on a self-addressed envelope
a self-addressed envelope for a reply

words.zhGloss: 贴好邮票的自址回邮信封
words.enDefinition: An envelope with your address and a stamp
acceptedZhAnswers: 贴好邮票的自址回邮信封

examples.en: I enclosed a self-addressed stamped envelope so the office could return my original document.
examples.zh: 我随信附上一个「贴好邮票的自址回邮信封」，方便办事处寄回我的文件原件。

examples.en: The self-addressed stamped envelope already had my new flat number written on it.
examples.zh: 「贴好邮票的自址回邮信封」上已经写了我的新公寓门牌号。

collocations: a reply in a self-addressed stamped envelope

words.enDefinition: An envelope supplied for sending a reply back

examples.en: I found the return envelope behind the letter about my registration documents.
examples.zh: 我在谈到登记文件的那封信后面找到了「回邮信封」。

examples.en: The return envelope was wide enough for the document without another fold.
examples.zh: 「回邮信封」够宽，文件不用再折一道。

words.enDefinition: The copy of a mailing document the sender keeps

examples.en: I saved the sender's copy of the mailing form with my other paperwork.
examples.zh: 我把邮寄单的「寄件人留存联」和其他手续文件一起保存。

examples.en: The postal clerk pointed out the sender's copy on the printed form.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员指出了打印表格上的「寄件人留存联」。

words.enDefinition: Stiff cardboard placed behind paper for support

examples.en: The certificate arrived with cardboard backing inside the envelope to keep it flat.
examples.zh: 证书随信封寄来，里面垫了「硬纸板衬底」，使它保持平整。

examples.en: I cut a piece of cardboard backing to fit the document envelope I had bought.
examples.zh: 我裁了一块「硬纸板衬底」，让它能放进我买的文件信封。

collocations: mail a document with cardboard backing

words.enDefinition: An envelope that has been damaged or torn

examples.en: The mailroom told me a damaged envelope from the council was waiting for me.
examples.zh: 邮件收发室告诉我，议会寄来的一个「破损的信封」在等我领取。

examples.en: I photographed the damaged envelope before asking the office about the contents.
examples.zh: 我先拍了「破损的信封」，再向办事处询问里面装了什么。

collocations: a damaged envelope from the post

words.enDefinition: A label showing where mail should be delivered

examples.en: I replaced the address label because the office name had changed since last term.
examples.zh: 办事处名称从上学期后就改了，所以我换了「地址贴签」。

examples.en: The postal clerk checked the address label before scanning the envelope at the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员在柜台扫信封之前，先核对了「地址贴签」。

words.enDefinition: The address where undeliverable mail can be sent back

examples.en: The campus mailroom asked me to put a return address on the envelope.
examples.zh: 校园邮件收发室请我在信封上写「退件地址」。

examples.en: I checked that the return address still showed my current campus residence.
examples.zh: 我确认了「退件地址」仍写的是我现在的学生宿舍。

collocations: the return address on an envelope

words.enDefinition: The name of the person receiving the mail

examples.en: I checked the recipient name against the office's letter before sealing the envelope.
examples.zh: 封信前，我对照办公室的来信核对了「收件人姓名」。

examples.en: The postal receipt printed the recipient name next to the destination information.
examples.zh: 邮寄凭条在目的地信息旁边印出了「收件人姓名」。

words.enDefinition: A phrase routing mail through a named intermediary

examples.en: The adviser suggested writing care of before the campus mailroom's name on the envelope.
examples.zh: 顾问建议在信封上校园邮件收发室的名称前写「由该机构代收」。

examples.en: I asked what care of meant below my name on the official letter.
examples.zh: 我问官方来信上我姓名下方的「由……代收」是什么意思。

collocations: send mail care of an office
address a letter care of someone
write care of on the address line

words.enDefinition: A numbered mailbox rented at a postal facility

examples.en: The agency printed its PO box on the reply envelope beside the office name.
examples.zh: 机构把「邮政信箱」印在回邮信封上，紧挨着办公室名称。

examples.en: I asked whether the PO box was the same one shown in the letter.
examples.zh: 我问信上显示的是不是同一个「邮政信箱」。

collocations: collect mail from a PO box

words.enDefinition: To write the recipient's details on an envelope

examples.en: I asked how to address an envelope to the department named in the letter.
examples.zh: 我问寄给信上写的部门时，怎样「在信封上写地址」。

examples.en: My flatmate helped me address an envelope for the document I was mailing.
examples.zh: 室友帮我「在寄文件的信封上写了地址」。

collocations: address an envelope to an office
check how to address an envelope

words.enDefinition: To close an envelope with its adhesive or seal

examples.en: The postal clerk showed me a table where I could seal an envelope.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员指给我看，有张桌子可以用来「封好信封」。

examples.en: I checked both pages before asking where I could seal an envelope at the counter.
examples.zh: 我先核对了信的两页内容，再问柜台哪里可以「封好信封」。

collocations: take a moment to seal an envelope
use adhesive to seal an envelope

words.enDefinition: A stamp affixed to mail as evidence of postage

examples.en: I picked up a postage stamp for the letter to the local office.
examples.zh: 我为寄给地方办事处的信买了一张「邮票」。

examples.en: The postal clerk pointed to where the postage stamp went on the sample envelope.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员指出了样本信封上「邮票」所贴的位置。

collocations: put a postage stamp on a letter

words.enDefinition: A small booklet containing several postage stamps

examples.en: I bought a book of stamps while I waited for the office to open.
examples.zh: 等办事处开门时，我买了「一本邮票」。

examples.en: The postal clerk showed me a book of stamps from the drawer below the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员从柜台下的抽屉里拿出「一本邮票」给我看。

collocations: use a stamp from a book of stamps

words.enDefinition: To attach a stamp or postage label

examples.en: The guide used affix postage when describing the space on the sample envelope.
examples.zh: 指南在说明样本信封上的位置时用了「贴上邮资凭证」一词。

examples.en: I asked where to affix postage on the envelope with the window.
examples.zh: 我问开窗信封的哪里可以「贴上邮资凭证」。

words.enDefinition: A label showing the postage for an item

examples.en: The postal clerk printed a postage label after checking the envelope at the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员核对柜台上的信封后，打印了「邮资标签」。

examples.en: I checked that the postage label was readable before handing over the document.
examples.zh: 交出文件之前，我确认了「邮资标签」能看清。

collocations: a postage label on an envelope

words.enDefinition: Postage still owed on a mailed item

examples.en: The notice showed postage due next to a reference for the official letter.
examples.zh: 通知在官方信件的编号旁标明了「待补缴的邮资」。

examples.en: I asked what postage due meant on the card from the postal operator.
examples.zh: 我问邮政运营机构卡片上写的「待补缴的邮资」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Postage that falls short of the required amount

examples.en: The returned envelope carried a note saying insufficient postage next to the label.
examples.zh: 退回的信封在标签旁贴了张条，写着「邮资不足」。

examples.en: The postal clerk explained what insufficient postage meant on the sample notice.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员解释了样本通知上的「邮资不足」是什么意思。

collocations: mark an envelope as having insufficient postage

words.enDefinition: A postal mark recording details such as mailing date

examples.en: I checked the date visible in the postmark on the official reply.
examples.zh: 我查看了官方回信「邮戳」上的日期。

examples.en: The postmark on my envelope was clearer on the original than in the photo.
examples.zh: 我的信封上，「邮戳」在原件上比照片里清楚。

words.enDefinition: A scale used to weigh items for mailing

examples.en: The clerk placed my document envelope on the postal scale near the counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员把我的文件信封放到柜台旁的「邮政秤」上。

examples.en: I saw the postal scale next to the display of different envelope sizes.
examples.zh: 我在不同尺寸信封的展示台旁看到了「邮政秤」。

collocations: put a letter on a postal scale

words.enDefinition: To measure how heavy a mailing envelope is

examples.en: Can I weigh an envelope at this counter before choosing a postal service?
examples.zh: 我可以先在这个柜台「给信封称重」，再选邮寄服务吗？

examples.en: The clerk showed me where I could weigh an envelope before buying postage.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看在哪里可以先「给信封称重」，再买邮资。

collocations: use a postal scale to weigh an envelope
ask where to weigh an envelope
weigh an envelope at the counter

words.enDefinition: A guide used to check the size of postal letters

examples.en: The postal clerk put my envelope against the letter size guide at the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员把我的信封贴到柜台的「信函尺寸测量板」上。

examples.en: The post office kept a letter size guide beside the display of stamps.
examples.zh: 邮局在邮票展示台旁放了一块「信函尺寸测量板」。

collocations: a letter size guide at the counter
check an envelope against a letter size guide

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政收件方付费回邮
words.enDefinition: A USPS service charging the recipient for replies
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政收件方付费回邮

examples.en: The reply envelope was marked Business Reply Mail above the name of the U.S. office.
examples.zh: 回邮信封在美国办事处名称上方标着「美国邮政收件方付费回邮」。

examples.en: The postal guide showed Business Reply Mail on a sample envelope for an application form.
examples.zh: 邮政指南在申请表的信封样本上展示了「美国邮政收件方付费回邮」的标记。

collocations: return a letter by Business Reply Mail

words.enDefinition: To send paperwork through the postal service

examples.en: The office told me which documents I could submit by post after signing them.
examples.zh: 办事处告诉我，哪些文件签字后可以「通过邮寄递交」。

examples.en: Can I submit by post if the original form is already on paper?
examples.zh: 如果表格原件本身就是纸质的，我可以「通过邮寄递交」吗？

collocations: be allowed to submit by post
submit by post instead of online

words.enDefinition: To send a document through the postal service

examples.en: I went to the counter to post a document for the university registry.
examples.zh: 我到柜台去「邮寄一份文件」，收件方是大学注册办公室。

examples.en: Could I post a document from this branch and get a receipt for it?
examples.zh: 我能在这个网点「邮寄一份文件」并拿到凭条吗？

collocations: post a document to an office

words.enDefinition: To ask to receive an item through the mail

examples.en: The form let me request delivery by post rather than collect the certificate in person.
examples.zh: 表格让我可以「要求邮寄送达」证书，不用亲自去取。

examples.en: Can I request delivery by post after the office has printed the document?
examples.zh: 办事处把文件打印出来以后，我还可以「要求邮寄送达」吗？

collocations: choose to request delivery by post
be able to request delivery by post
a form to request delivery by post

words.enDefinition: To send the original papers through the mail

examples.en: The adviser showed me which section discussed whether to mail the original documents.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，哪一节讨论是否要「邮寄文件原件」。

examples.en: I asked whether I should mail the original documents or bring them to the appointment.
examples.zh: 我问是要「邮寄文件原件」，还是预约办理时带过去。

collocations: ask whether to mail the original documents
mail the original documents to an office
instructions about when to mail the original documents

words.enDefinition: Directions for sending an item through the mail

examples.en: I read the mailing instructions before choosing an envelope for the signed documents.
examples.zh: 为已签署的文件挑信封之前，我读了「邮寄说明」。

examples.en: The mailing instructions on the last page named the office responsible for receiving documents.
examples.zh: 通知最后一页的「邮寄说明」写明了负责收件的办事处。

words.enDefinition: A phrase giving the latest acceptable postmark date

examples.en: The office notice used “Postmarked by” beside the date on the instruction sheet.
examples.zh: 办事处的通知在说明单的日期旁写着「邮戳日期不得晚于」。

examples.en: I asked what “postmarked by” meant in the letter about submitting paper copies.
examples.zh: 我问关于递交纸质副本的信中，「邮戳日期不得晚于」是什么意思。

collocations: an envelope postmarked by the stated date

words.enDefinition: The latest acceptable date on the postal marking

examples.en: I checked the postmark deadline after reading the section about sending the form.
examples.zh: 读过寄送表格的部分后，我查了「邮戳截止日期」。

examples.en: The notice listed a postmark deadline separately from the date the office would start reviewing.
examples.zh: 通知把「邮戳截止日期」和办事处开始审核的日期分开列出。

words.enDefinition: The date a letter or document was sent out

examples.en: The agency gave a dispatch date for the certificate in its reply to me.
examples.zh: 机构在回复中给出了证书的「寄出日期」。

examples.en: I compared the dispatch date in my email with the date on the envelope.
examples.zh: 我把邮件里的「寄出日期」和信封上的日期作了对照。

words.enDefinition: A regular postal service without special handling

examples.en: I asked how standard mail was named on the form at the counter.
examples.zh: 我问柜台的表格用什么名称标示「普通邮件服务」。

examples.en: The office sent the notice by standard mail in the example we discussed.
examples.zh: 在我们讨论的例子里，办事处用「普通邮件服务」寄出了通知。

words.enDefinition: Mail sent within a single country

examples.en: The clerk showed which part of the form was marked for domestic mail.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看，表格哪一部分标明用于「国内邮件」。

examples.en: The sign above the counter listed options for domestic mail on the left.
examples.zh: 柜台上方的牌子在左边列出了「国内邮件」的寄送选项。

words.enDefinition: Mail sent from one country to another

examples.en: I asked which counter handled international mail before taking out my document envelope.
examples.zh: 拿出文件信封前，我问哪个柜台办理「国际邮件」。

examples.en: The postal guide listed international mail separately from services within the country.
examples.zh: 邮政指南把「国际邮件」和国内服务分开列出。

words.enDefinition: Mail carried by air for part of its journey

examples.en: I noticed the word airmail printed on the envelope from the overseas university.
examples.zh: 我注意到海外大学寄来的信封上印着「航空邮件」。

examples.en: The example showed an airmail sticker beside the country name on the envelope.
examples.zh: 例图中，信封的国家名称旁贴着一张「航空邮件」贴纸。

words.enDefinition: Mail whose progress can be checked through tracking records

examples.en: I chose tracked mail for the document the agency was expecting from me.
examples.zh: 为了寄送机构等着收的文件，我选了「可追踪邮件」。

examples.en: The office gave me a code for tracked mail in its dispatch message.
examples.zh: 办事处在寄出通知中给了我一个「可追踪邮件」的查询编号。

words.enDefinition: A postal service that records an item and gives it extra security in transit

examples.en: I sent the only original by registered mail to keep a record of its journey.
examples.zh: 我把唯一的原件用「挂号邮件」寄出，以便留存寄送记录。

examples.en: The clerk kept the registered mail in a separate tray behind the counter.
examples.zh: 办事员把「挂号邮件」单独放在柜台后面的一个托盘里。

collocations: send a letter by registered mail

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政认证邮件服务
words.enDefinition: A USPS service recording mailing and delivery or attempted delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政认证邮件服务

examples.en: I recognized Certified Mail on the USPS receipt for the document I'd sent.
examples.zh: 我在已寄出文件的美国邮政凭条上认出了「认证邮件服务」这个字样。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to Certified Mail when I asked about the evidence of mailing.
examples.zh: 我问起交寄凭证时，工作人员指了指「美国邮政认证邮件服务」的选项。

collocations: send an item by Certified Mail

words.zhGloss: 英国皇家邮政签收服务
words.enDefinition: A Royal Mail service that records a delivery signature
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国皇家邮政签收服务

examples.en: The UK post office receipt listed Royal Mail Signed For below the date.
examples.zh: 英国邮局的凭条在日期下面列出了「皇家邮政签收服务」。

examples.en: I asked where Royal Mail Signed For appeared on the receipt from the counter.
examples.zh: 我问柜台给的凭条上哪里写了「英国皇家邮政签收服务」。

collocations: send a letter by Royal Mail Signed For
a Royal Mail Signed For item
a Royal Mail Signed For receipt

words.zhGloss: 英国皇家邮政限时保障寄递
words.enDefinition: A named Royal Mail service for timed delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国皇家邮政限时保障寄递

examples.en: The handbook showed Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed on the UK postal options page.
examples.zh: 手册在英国邮寄选项的页面上列出了「皇家邮政限时保障寄递」。

examples.en: I recognized Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed on the envelope from the British office.
examples.zh: 我在英国办事处寄来的信封上认出了「皇家邮政限时保障寄递」的标记。

collocations: a Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed label
a Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed receipt
send by Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed

words.enDefinition: Royal Mail's first-class service for UK mail

examples.en: The UK counter sign listed first-class post beside the other options for letters.
examples.zh: 英国柜台的牌子把「一类邮件服务」和其他寄信选项列在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether first-class post was the option shown on the British sample envelope.
examples.zh: 我问英国样本信封上标的是不是「一类邮件服务」。

collocations: send a letter by first-class post

words.enDefinition: Royal Mail's second-class service for UK mail

examples.en: The clerk showed me where second-class post appeared on the UK service chart.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看，英国邮寄服务表上哪里写着「二类邮件服务」。

examples.en: I found a receipt for second-class post beneath my other letters from Britain.
examples.zh: 我在其他英国来信下面找到了一张「二类邮件服务」的凭条。

collocations: send a letter by second-class post

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政一类邮件服务
words.enDefinition: A USPS service for letters and lightweight mail
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政一类邮件服务

examples.en: The American postal guide included First-Class Mail in its section on letters.
examples.zh: 美国邮政指南在信函部分提到了「一类邮件服务」。

examples.en: I saw First-Class Mail printed below the barcode on the U.S. envelope.
examples.zh: 我看到美国信封的条形码下方印着「一类邮件服务」。

collocations: send a letter by First-Class Mail

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政优先邮件服务
words.enDefinition: A USPS service for faster delivery of mail
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政优先邮件服务

examples.en: The U.S. office used a Priority Mail envelope for the printed certificate.
examples.zh: 美国办事处用「邮政优先邮件服务」的信封寄送打印好的证书。

examples.en: I checked where the Priority Mail label appeared on the envelope from America.
examples.zh: 我查看了美国寄来的信封上「邮政优先邮件服务」标签的位置。

words.enDefinition: A named Canada Post service for expedited delivery

examples.en: The Canadian receipt showed Xpresspost above the reference for the document envelope.
examples.zh: 加拿大邮政凭条在文件信封编号上方印了「特快寄递」。

examples.en: I asked whether Xpresspost was the service named on the Canada Post label.
examples.zh: 我问加拿大邮政标签上写的服务是不是「特快寄递」。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚邮政特快寄递
words.enDefinition: Australia Post's named expedited delivery service
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚邮政特快寄递

examples.en: The Australian postal counter displayed Express Post envelopes beside the ordinary mailing supplies.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚邮政柜台在普通邮寄用品旁摆了「特快寄递」信封。

examples.en: I checked the Australian receipt to see whether it said Express Post.
examples.zh: 我查看了澳大利亚的凭条，看看上面是否写着「特快寄递」。

collocations: an Australia Post Express Post envelope
send an item by Express Post

words.enDefinition: A USPS document showing that an item was presented for mailing

examples.en: I asked for a certificate of mailing when I handed over the envelope.
examples.zh: 我交寄信封时，索要了一份「美国邮政交寄证明」。

examples.en: The clerk stamped the certificate of mailing with the date the letter was accepted.
examples.zh: 柜台工作人员在「美国邮政交寄证明」上盖了邮戳，注明信件收寄日期。

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an item was handed over for posting

examples.en: I kept the proof of posting for the letter I sent to the college.
examples.zh: 我留着寄给学院那封信的「交寄凭证」。

examples.en: The office asked whether I had proof of posting when the envelope was late.
examples.zh: 信封迟到时，办事处问我有没有「交寄凭证」。

words.enDefinition: A receipt issued for a postal transaction

examples.en: I folded the postal receipt and put it in my document folder.
examples.zh: 我把「邮寄凭条」折好，放进文件夹。

examples.en: The postal receipt showed which service I had used for the letter.
examples.zh: 「邮寄凭条」显示了我寄信时用的是哪种服务。

collocations: a reference on the postal receipt

words.enDefinition: An individual item handled as mail

examples.en: The U.S. postal guide used mailpiece when describing the identifier on each envelope.
examples.zh: 美国邮政指南在介绍每个信封上的标识时，用了「单件邮寄物品」一词。

examples.en: The clerk asked which mailpiece the reference number belonged to in the tracking record.
examples.zh: 工作人员问，追踪记录中这个编号对应哪件「邮寄物品」。

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an item was delivered

examples.en: I asked where the proof of delivery appeared on the postal service's website.
examples.zh: 我问邮政服务网站上哪里显示「送达证明」。

examples.en: The registration office asked for proof of delivery for the documents in my case.
examples.zh: 登记办事处请我提供本次事务相关文件的「送达证明」。

words.zhGloss: 寄回寄件人的签收回执
words.enDefinition: A signed delivery record sent back to the sender
acceptedZhAnswers: 寄回寄件人的签收回执

examples.en: My return receipt showed that someone at the admissions desk had signed for the envelope.
examples.zh: 我的「签收回执」显示，招生处前台有人签收了信封。

examples.en: We filed the return receipt beside the copy of the letter we had mailed.
examples.zh: 我们把「签收回执」和寄出信函的副本一起存档。

words.enDefinition: Delivery that records a signature when mail is handed over

examples.en: The letter mentioned signed-for delivery in the section about returning the certificate.
examples.zh: 信在介绍寄回证书的部分提到了「签收投递」。

examples.en: I asked which option on the board was for signed-for delivery at this branch.
examples.zh: 我问这个网点的牌子上哪个选项是「签收投递」。

words.enDefinition: A notice that delivery requires a signature

examples.en: The label said “Signature required” next to the reference for the document.
examples.zh: 标签在文件编号旁写着「需要签收」。

examples.en: I saw “Signature required” on the envelope from the local government office.
examples.zh: 我在地方政府办事处寄来的信封上看到了「需要签收」。

words.enDefinition: A signature recorded when an item is delivered

examples.en: The office asked me to check the delivery signature in the tracking record.
examples.zh: 办事处让我查看追踪记录中的「投递签名」。

examples.en: I could see the delivery signature beside the date on the screen.
examples.zh: 我在屏幕上看到「投递签名」就在日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying no signature is expected for delivery

examples.en: The label said “No signature required” on one of the two sample envelopes.
examples.zh: 两份样本信封中的一份标着「无须签收」。

examples.en: I checked whether “No signature required” appeared in the delivery details for my letter.
examples.zh: 我查了信件的投递详情里是否显示「无须签收」。

collocations: a service listed as no signature required

words.enDefinition: A page showing the progress of a mailed item

examples.en: I opened the tracking page after receiving the message from the registration office.
examples.zh: 收到登记办事处发来的消息后，我打开了「邮件追踪页面」。

examples.en: The tracking page displayed the dates of each update for my document envelope.
examples.zh: 「邮件追踪页面」显示了我文件信封每次状态更新的日期。

collocations: a link to the tracking page

words.enDefinition: A list of past tracking updates for mail

examples.en: I looked through the tracking history to see when the envelope was accepted.
examples.zh: 我查阅了「邮件追踪记录」，看信封什么时候被收寄。

examples.en: The tracking history showed two earlier updates below the latest entry.
examples.zh: 「邮件追踪记录」在最新一条记录下面列了两条较早的更新。

collocations: an entry in the tracking history

words.enDefinition: A recorded scan updating an item's progress

examples.en: The tracking scan showed that the envelope had reached a sorting facility.
examples.zh: 「邮件追踪扫描记录」显示，信封已到达分拣设施。

examples.en: I checked where the most recent tracking scan was listed on the page.
examples.zh: 我查看了页面上最新一条「邮件追踪扫描记录」的位置。

words.enDefinition: A recorded scan made when mail is delivered

examples.en: The delivery scan was the final entry on the tracking page for my letter.
examples.zh: 「送达扫描记录」是我那封信追踪页面上的最后一条记录。

examples.en: The office asked which date was shown beside the delivery scan for that envelope.
examples.zh: 办事处问那个信封的「送达扫描记录」旁显示的是哪个日期。

collocations: a delivery scan on the record

words.enDefinition: A barcode used to identify an item for tracking

examples.en: The clerk scanned the tracking barcode after placing my envelope on the counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员把信封放上柜台后，扫描了「邮件追踪条码」。

examples.en: The tracking barcode was still readable even though the corner had been folded.
examples.zh: 虽然有个角被折了起来，「邮件追踪条码」还是能看清。

collocations: a tracking barcode on a label

words.enDefinition: A message telling the recipient that something was sent

examples.en: I received a dispatch notification for the documents from the local office.
examples.zh: 我收到了地方办事处发来的文件「寄出通知」。

examples.en: The dispatch notification gave a reference for the envelope containing my certificate.
examples.zh: 「寄出通知」给出了装有我证书的那个信封的编号。

words.enDefinition: Using postal records to check an item's progress

examples.en: The sample showed how postal tracking listed the envelope's progress through the network.
examples.zh: 样本展示了「邮政追踪查询」如何列出信封在邮政网络中的进度。

examples.en: I asked which section of the official letter referred to postal tracking.
examples.zh: 我问官方来信哪一部分提到了「邮政追踪查询」。

words.enDefinition: A letter brought directly to its destination by someone

examples.en: The office kept a record of the hand-delivered letter beside the posted documents.
examples.zh: 办事处在已邮寄文件旁保留了「专人送达的信件」记录。

examples.en: The reception desk signed for the hand-delivered letter from the nearby municipal office.
examples.zh: 接待处签收了附近市政办事处「专人送达的信件」。

collocations: a hand-delivered letter from an office

words.enDefinition: A tracking update that the shipping label exists

examples.en: The tracking page showed “Label created” after the office prepared the document envelope.
examples.zh: 办事处准备好文件信封后，追踪页面显示「邮寄标签已创建」。

examples.en: I saw “Label created” next to the reference in the office's first message.
examples.zh: 我在办事处发来的第一条消息里看到编号旁写着「邮寄标签已创建」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying a post office accepted the item

examples.en: The first update said “Accepted at post office” below the date and time.
examples.zh: 第一条更新在日期和时间下写着「邮局已收寄」。

examples.en: I saved the update marked “Accepted at post office” with my mailing receipt.
examples.zh: 我把标为「邮局已收寄」的更新和邮寄凭条一起保存了。

collocations: a status reading “Accepted at post office”

words.enDefinition: Transferred to the organization carrying the item

examples.en: The agency's record listed “Handed to carrier” after the envelope was prepared.
examples.zh: 机构的记录显示，信封准备好后便「已交给承运方」。

examples.en: I saw “Handed to carrier” in the status column for my document envelope.
examples.zh: 我在文件信封的状态栏里看到了「已交给承运方」。

words.enDefinition: On the way between sender and destination

examples.en: The document was still in transit when I checked the tracking page after class.
examples.zh: 我下课查看追踪页面时，文件还在「运输途中」。

examples.en: The office message said the envelope was in transit and gave the tracking reference.
examples.zh: 办事处的消息说信封在「运输途中」，并给出了追踪编号。

words.enDefinition: A facility where mail is sorted for delivery

examples.en: The tracking record showed that my letter had reached a mail sorting centre.
examples.zh: 追踪记录显示，我的信已到达「邮件分拣中心」。

examples.en: I wrote down the mail sorting centre named in the update from the operator.
examples.zh: 我记下了邮政运营机构更新中提到的「邮件分拣中心」。

collocations: pass through a mail sorting centre

words.enDefinition: A status showing an item is on its delivery round

examples.en: The envelope was marked “Out for delivery” when I left for my lecture.
examples.zh: 我出门上课时，信封的状态标为「正在派送」。

examples.en: I saw “Out for delivery” under the address details on the tracking page.
examples.zh: 我在追踪页面的地址详情下方看到了「正在派送」。

words.enDefinition: An occasion when a carrier tries to deliver mail

examples.en: The record showed a delivery attempt before I had returned home from campus.
examples.zh: 记录显示，在我从学校回家之前有过「一次投递尝试」。

examples.en: I asked which date on the message referred to the delivery attempt.
examples.zh: 我问消息上的哪个日期对应那「一次投递尝试」。

words.enDefinition: A notice left after an unsuccessful delivery attempt

examples.en: I found a missed delivery notice inside the door when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回家时，在门内发现了一张「未能送达通知」。

examples.en: The missed delivery notice named the office where the envelope was being held.
examples.zh: 「未能送达通知」写明了信封暂存在什么办事点。

collocations: details on a missed delivery notice

words.enDefinition: Kept at a location for the recipient to collect

examples.en: The tracking status changed to “Held for pickup” after the delivery attempt.
examples.zh: 尝试投递后，追踪状态变成了「已留存待领取」。

examples.en: I asked which counter handled letters marked “Held for pickup” at this branch.
examples.zh: 我问这个网点哪个柜台处理标为「已留存待领取」的信件。

collocations: mark mail as held for pickup

words.enDefinition: The latest date or time an item can be collected

examples.en: The card listed a collection deadline beside the name of the delivery office.
examples.zh: 通知卡在投递办事点名称旁列出了「领取截止日期」。

examples.en: I asked about the collection deadline because the listed branch opened after my first class.
examples.zh: 因为卡上那个网点在我第一节课结束后才开门，我问了「领取截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying the intended recipient was unavailable

examples.en: The update showed “Recipient unavailable” after the carrier tried to deliver the envelope.
examples.zh: 邮递员尝试送信封后，更新显示「暂时联系不到收件人」。

examples.en: I asked what “Recipient unavailable” meant on the record for the document.
examples.zh: 我问文件的记录上「暂时联系不到收件人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A notice that a delivery location could not be reached

examples.en: The carrier recorded “No access” when the main door to the residence was locked.
examples.zh: 学生宿舍的大门锁着，邮递员记下「无法进入投递地点」。

examples.en: I saw “No access” beside the attempted delivery date on the online record.
examples.zh: 我在网上记录的尝试投递日期旁边看到了「无法进入投递地点」。

words.enDefinition: An address missing information needed for delivery

examples.en: The postal record showed “Incomplete address” beside the reference for my envelope.
examples.zh: 邮政记录在我信封的编号旁标了「地址不完整」。

examples.en: I asked which detail was missing from the incomplete address on the returned letter.
examples.zh: 我问退回信件上那处「不完整的地址」缺了哪项信息。

collocations: a letter with an incomplete address

words.enDefinition: A notice that the addressee could not be identified there

examples.en: The returned envelope had a stamp saying “Addressee unknown” beside the name.
examples.zh: 退回的信封在姓名旁盖了一个章，写着「无法确认收件人」。

examples.en: I asked the postal clerk what “Addressee unknown” meant in the delivery record.
examples.zh: 我问邮局柜台工作人员，投递记录里的「无法确认收件人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: No new address is available for forwarding the item

examples.en: The returned mail had “No forwarding address” printed beside the old delivery details.
examples.zh: 退件在旧的投递信息旁边印着「没有改寄地址」。

examples.en: I asked how the office had recorded “No forwarding address” in the case file.
examples.zh: 我问办事处在本次事务档案里是怎么记录「没有改寄地址」的。

collocations: report that there is no forwarding address

words.enDefinition: Mail that cannot be delivered as addressed

examples.en: The report listed undeliverable mail separately from letters still on their way.
examples.zh: 报告把「无法投递的邮件」和仍在运送途中的信件分开列出。

examples.en: I saw an explanation for undeliverable mail on the back of the notice.
examples.zh: 我在通知背面看到了对「无法投递的邮件」的说明。

words.enDefinition: A status saying the item was left in the mailbox

examples.en: The screen said “Delivered to mailbox,” so I checked the box for my flat.
examples.zh: 屏幕显示「已投进邮箱」，我就去看了我住处的邮箱。

examples.en: I saw “Delivered to mailbox” beside the date in the postal tracking record.
examples.zh: 我在邮政追踪记录的日期旁看到了「已投进邮箱」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying the item was handed to reception staff

examples.en: The update said “Delivered to reception” for the letter sent to my residence.
examples.zh: 寄给我宿舍那封信的更新显示「已交给接待处」。

examples.en: I showed the receptionist the “Delivered to reception” entry from the tracking page.
examples.zh: 我把追踪页面上「已交给接待处」的记录给接待员看了。

words.enDefinition: A notice saying delivery was made to a neighbour

examples.en: The delivery card said “Left with neighbour” and showed which door to ask at.
examples.zh: 投递通知卡写着「已由邻居代收」，并标出了该去敲哪扇门。

examples.en: I saw “Left with neighbour” in the tracking details after coming home from campus.
examples.zh: 我从学校回家后，在追踪详情里看到了「已由邻居代收」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying mail was left in a sheltered or designated spot

examples.en: The delivery note said “Left in a safe place” for the envelope from campus.
examples.zh: 学校寄来的信封在投递说明里显示「已放在安全处」。

examples.en: I checked which location the “Left in a safe place” update referred to.
examples.zh: 我查看了「已放在安全处」这条更新说的是哪个位置。

collocations: a “Left in a safe place” note
mark an item as left in a safe place
a delivery left in a safe place

words.enDefinition: A status saying the item was handed to a representative

examples.en: I asked the mailroom what “Delivered to agent” meant on the U.S. tracking page.
examples.zh: 我问邮件收发室，美国追踪页面上的「已交给代收人」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to “Delivered to agent” on the record for that envelope.
examples.zh: 工作人员指着那个信封的记录里「已交给代收人」的字样。

words.enDefinition: A tracking label introducing the recorded signer

examples.en: The delivery record showed “Signed by” beside the receptionist's initials on the screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的投递记录在接待员姓名首字母旁写着「签收人为」。

examples.en: I asked whether the name after “Signed by” belonged to the front desk worker.
examples.zh: 我问「签收人为」后面的姓名是不是前台工作人员的。

words.enDefinition: A correction to the address for a particular delivery

examples.en: The office noted a delivery address correction for the certificate envelope in my file.
examples.zh: 办事处在我的档案里记录了证书信封的「投递地址更正」。

examples.en: I asked whether the message about a delivery address correction referred to the same document.
examples.zh: 我问「投递地址更正」的消息是不是指同一份文件。

collocations: a message about a delivery address correction

words.enDefinition: To change the address recorded for receiving mail

examples.en: The letter explained where you could update your mailing address in the agency's records.
examples.zh: 信中说明了可以在哪里「更新机构记录中的邮寄地址」。

examples.en: Can you update your mailing address after moving to another student residence?
examples.zh: 搬到另一处学生宿舍后，你能「更新邮寄地址」吗？

collocations: ask how to update your mailing address
need to update your mailing address
a form to update your mailing address

words.enDefinition: A request to send mail to another address

examples.en: I saved the confirmation for the forwarding request before leaving my old flat.
examples.zh: 离开旧住处之前，我保存了「邮件改寄申请」的确认信息。

examples.en: The postal operator gave me a reference for the forwarding request I had made.
examples.zh: 邮政运营机构给了我已经提交的「邮件改寄申请」编号。

collocations: a reference for a forwarding request

words.enDefinition: Forwarding mail to another address for a limited period

examples.en: The postal guide listed temporary mail forwarding in a section for people relocating briefly.
examples.zh: 邮政指南在介绍短期搬迁的章节里列出了「临时邮件改寄」。

examples.en: I asked whether the notice referred to temporary mail forwarding or a permanent address update.
examples.zh: 我问通知指的是「临时邮件改寄」，还是永久性地址更新。

words.enDefinition: A service that temporarily keeps mail instead of delivering it

examples.en: I read the section on mail hold before leaving the residence for the holidays.
examples.zh: 放假离开宿舍之前，我读了有关「邮件暂存服务」的部分。

examples.en: The postal operator sent a confirmation for the mail hold I had requested.
examples.zh: 邮政运营机构发来确认，说明收到了我提出的「邮件暂存服务」申请。

words.enDefinition: To collect a mailed item for another person

examples.en: Can I collect mail on behalf of my flatmate if the letter is in her name?
examples.zh: 如果信件上写的是室友的名字，我可以「代她领取邮件」吗？

examples.en: The notice explained who could collect mail on behalf of the person named on the envelope.
examples.zh: 通知解释了谁可以「代信封上写的人领取邮件」。

collocations: ask to collect mail on behalf of a friend
be allowed to collect mail on behalf of someone
collect mail on behalf of a recipient

words.enDefinition: Another attempt to deliver an item

examples.en: The card gave a contact number for redelivery but also mentioned collection.
examples.zh: 通知卡给了「再次投递」的联系电话，也提到了自取。

examples.en: I asked about redelivery after finding the notice beneath the front door.
examples.zh: 在正门下面发现通知后，我问了「再次投递」的事。

words.enDefinition: To arrange a time for another delivery attempt

examples.en: The postal website showed where I could schedule a redelivery for the envelope.
examples.zh: 邮政网站显示，我可以在哪里为信封「预约再次投递」。

examples.en: Can I schedule a redelivery for a day when someone is at reception?
examples.zh: 我能选接待处有人的一天「预约再次投递」吗？

collocations: ask how to schedule a redelivery
a link to schedule a redelivery

words.enDefinition: The scheduled day for another delivery attempt

examples.en: I checked the redelivery date against my lecture timetable before confirming it.
examples.zh: 确认「再次投递日期」前，我对照了自己的课表。

examples.en: The redelivery date was shown above the reference on the new confirmation page.
examples.zh: 新的确认页面在编号上方显示了「再次投递日期」。

words.enDefinition: A notice confirming that another delivery attempt is scheduled

examples.en: The redelivery confirmation listed the new date beside the reference for my letter.
examples.zh: 「再次投递确认通知」在信件编号旁列出了新的日期。

examples.en: I saved the redelivery confirmation before closing the browser on my phone.
examples.zh: 关闭手机浏览器前，我保存了「再次投递确认通知」。

words.enDefinition: A direction or status indicating mail is going back

examples.en: The label said “Return to sender” beneath the address on the envelope.
examples.zh: 标签在信封地址下方写着「退回寄件人」。

examples.en: I checked what “Return to sender” meant for the document listed in the notice.
examples.zh: 我核实了通知里那份文件标为「退回寄件人」的含义。

words.enDefinition: An envelope sent back to the original sender

examples.en: I brought the returned envelope to the office to ask about its label.
examples.zh: 我带着「退回的信封」去办事处，询问上面的标签。

examples.en: The returned envelope was attached to the file with a note from the clerk.
examples.zh: 「退回的信封」连同工作人员的便条附在档案上。

collocations: a label on the returned envelope

words.enDefinition: An explanation of why an item was sent back

examples.en: The reason for return appeared on a sticker above the original postage.
examples.zh: 「退件原因」写在原邮资标记上方的贴纸上。

examples.en: I asked which section of the tracking page stated the reason for return.
examples.zh: 我问追踪页面的哪一部分写明了「退件原因」。

words.enDefinition: Written communication sent by or to an authority

examples.en: The student office kept official correspondence in a separate section of my file.
examples.zh: 学生办公室在我的档案里单设一栏存放「官方往来函件」。

examples.en: I checked whether the envelope came from the address used for official correspondence.
examples.zh: 我查看了信封是不是从收发「官方往来函件」的地址寄出的。

words.enDefinition: Written communications sent on paper

examples.en: The portal asked whether I wanted paper correspondence from the office about this request.
examples.zh: 门户问我是否希望收到办事处就这件事寄来的「纸质往来函件」。

examples.en: I filed the paper correspondence beside the printout of the tracking record.
examples.zh: 我把「纸质往来函件」和追踪记录的打印件放在一起归档。

words.enDefinition: Mail not collected by the intended recipient

examples.en: The delivery office kept a record of unclaimed mail for the previous week.
examples.zh: 投递办事点保存了上一周「无人领取的邮件」的记录。

examples.en: I saw a section about unclaimed mail on the back of the notice.
examples.zh: 我在通知背面看到了一栏介绍「无人领取的邮件」。

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政遗失邮件查找
words.enDefinition: A USPS request to look for missing mail
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政遗失邮件查找

examples.en: The U.S. postal page listed Missing Mail Search in a section about delayed items.
examples.zh: 美国邮政页面在延迟邮件栏目中列出了「遗失邮件查找」。

examples.en: I wrote down which details the Missing Mail Search screen asked me to provide.
examples.zh: 我记下了「美国邮政遗失邮件查找」页面要求提供哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: To follow a letter's progress using tracking records

examples.en: Can I track a letter sent to the registration office from this branch?
examples.zh: 从这个网点寄给登记办事处的信，我能「查询信件投递进度」吗？

examples.en: The receipt showed which reference I could use to track a letter online.
examples.zh: 凭条显示了我可以用哪个编号在线「查询信件投递进度」。

collocations: use a reference to track a letter
ask how to track a letter

words.enDefinition: To deliver a mailed item into a numbered post office box

examples.en: I asked whether this service could deliver to a PO box in the city.
examples.zh: 我问这项服务能不能「投递到市区的邮政信箱」。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the postal service could deliver to a PO box.
examples.zh: 工作人员核实了这项邮政服务能不能「投递到邮政信箱」。

collocations: arrange to deliver to a PO box
be able to deliver to a PO box
ask whether they deliver to a PO box
